preconditions.description: The number of rows in the table is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of columns in the table is between 1 and 100, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of applications of the first spell (a) is non-negative.
The number of applications of the second spell (b) is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(row_numbers[i] >= 1 and row_numbers[i] <= n for i in range(a))
postconditions.description: Each row number in the list of row numbers to apply the first spell is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(col_numbers[i] >= 1 and col_numbers[i] <= m for i in range(b))
postconditions.description: Each column number in the list of column numbers to apply the second spell is between 1 and m, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(table[row_numbers[i] - 1][j] >= 0 for i in range(a) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: After applying the first spell to the specified rows, all numbers in these rows are non-negative.
After applying the second spell to the specified columns, all numbers in these columns are non-negative.

postconditions.expression: sum(table[i][j] for j in range(m)) >= 0 for i in range(n)
postconditions.description: The sum of the numbers in each row is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: sum(table[i][j] for i in range(n)) >= 0 for j in range(m)
postconditions.description: The sum of the numbers in each column is non-negative.
